newsitem.title: MEXICO: Robbers hold at least one hostage at Mexican bank.
newsitem.headline: Robbers hold at least one hostage at Mexican bank.

text.p: Armed robbers were holding at least one woman hostage inside a bank on Monday after a brief shootout with police who foiled their attempted holdup.

One woman who had earlier been held hostage in the bank told Reuters that a man armed with a hand grenade led the assault and initially took about 15 hostages when the bank became surrounded by police.
Gayne Quiroz, 19 years old, said she was released with about 13 others but that her 45-year-old step-mother and another hostage were inside.

About 100 police surrounded the Bancomer branch in the eastern part of the capital, aiming handguns and shotguns through the open door of the bank, but commanding officers would not comment on the situation inside.

The Mexican government news agency Notimex said one officer was injured in the hand and a civilian was shot in the leg during a brief exchange of gunfire as police arrived at the start of the robbery.
The agency also reported that the robbers were demanding an escape vehicle.
